Watch an RNN's State Evolve.zh: 观察 RNN 的状态演化

A recurrent network is just one small ce.zh:
循环网络不过是一个小单元被反复应用而已。它维护一个
      持续演化的隐藏状态 $h_t$，并在每个时间步以 @@T0@@相同的@@T1@@ 权重
      将下一个输入折叠进该状态。设定权重，喂入一个序列，
      然后按 @@T2@@步进@@T3@@，观察整个序列如何逐步坍缩为
      单个数值，一个时间步一个时间步地展开。
A recurrent network is just one small ce.src: A recurrent network is just one small cell applied over and over. It keeps a running hidden state $h_t$, and at every timestep it folds the next input into that state with the same weights. Set the weights, feed a sequence, and press Step to watch a whole sequence collapse into a single number, one timestep at a time.

@@T0@@~8 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.zh:
@@T0@@约 8 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 序列 · RNN@@T3@@

One cell, applied over and over.src: One cell, applied over and over

Take the simplest possible recurrent uni.zh:
取尽可能最简单的循环单元：一个标量隐藏状态 $h_t$。
      每一步它读取一个输入 $x_t$，将其与之前的状态混合，
      再通过 $\tanh$ 将结果压缩：
Take the simplest possible recurrent uni.src:
Take the simplest possible recurrent unit: a single scalar hidden state $h_t$.
      At each step it reads one input $x_t$, mixes it with the previous state, and
      squashes the result through $\tanh$:

There are only three numbers to learn &m.zh:
需要学习的只有三个数值 — $w_x$（新输入的影响强度）、
      $w_h$（过去的影响强度）以及偏置 $b$ — 它们在
      @@T0@@每个时间步之间共享@@T1@@。这种权重共享正是全部要旨：
      任意长度的序列都由同一个微小的函数处理，而网络的
      全部记忆都存在于那个持续演化的单一数值 $h_t$ 之中。
There are only three numbers to learn &m.src: There are only three numbers to learn — $w_x$ (how strongly the new input matters), $w_h$ (how strongly the past matters), and a bias $b$ — and they are shared across every timestep. That weight sharing is the whole idea: a sequence of any length is processed by the same tiny function, and all the network's memory lives in the single running number $h_t$.

Choose an input sequence, set the three.zh:
选择一个输入序列，设定三个权重，然后按 @@T0@@步进@@T1@@。
      每按一次，$t$ 便前进一格，并展示代入具体数值后的精确
      运算过程 — 随后在轨迹上绘出新的状态。观察
      循环权重 $w_h$ 如何决定状态是趋于稳定、振荡、饱和，
      还是（在线性模式下）爆炸。
Choose an input sequence, set the three.src: Choose an input sequence, set the three weights, and press Step. Each press advances $t$ by one and shows the exact arithmetic with the numbers substituted in — then plots the new state on the trajectory. Watch how the recurrent weight $w_h$ decides whether the state settles, oscillates, saturates, or (in linear mode) blows up.

Or type your own (comma-separated).zh: 或自行输入（以逗号分隔）

Hidden state $h_t$ against timestep $t$..zh:
隐藏状态 $h_t$ 随时间步 $t$ 的变化。实心圆点为已揭示的步；
      浅色虚线预览当前权重将走向何处。底部的灰色竖线表示输入 $x_t$。
Hidden state $h_t$ against timestep $t$..src: Hidden state $h_t$ against timestep $t$. Filled dots are revealed steps; the faint dashed line previews where the current weights are heading. Grey stems at the bottom show the input $x_t$.

@@T0@@Push $w_h$ toward 2 and step throu.zh:
@@T0@@将 $w_h$ 推向 2，并用阶跃输入逐步推进。@@T1@@ 在
      @@T2@@tanh@@T3@@ 模式下，状态迅速冲至 $+1$ 并钉在那里 — 它
      @@T4@@饱和@@T5@@ 了，此后再多的输入也几乎无法使其移动。切换到
      @@T6@@线性@@T7@@ 模式并保持相同的 $w_h > 1$，状态反而每步
      翻倍：它 @@T8@@爆炸@@T9@@ 了。这单个旋钮 $w_h$，便是整个
      梯度消失 / 爆炸问题的缩影。
@@T0@@Push $w_h$ toward 2 and step throu.src: Push $w_h$ toward 2 and step through the Step input. In tanh mode the state races to $+1$ and pins there — it saturates, and any further input barely moves it. Switch to linear mode with the same $w_h > 1$ and the state instead doubles every step: it explodes. That single knob, $w_h$, is the entire vanishing / exploding story in miniature.

A sequence, folded into one number.zh: 一个序列，折叠为一个数值
A sequence, folded into one number.src: A sequence, folded into one number

Nothing above ever stored the sequence..zh:
上文的一切从未存储整个序列。在第 $t$ 步，该单元只看到
      $x_t$ 与那个被携带的单一数值 $h_{t-1}$ — 然而 $h_t$ 依赖于
      @@T0@@完整的@@T1@@ 历史 $x_1,\dots,x_t$，因为每个状态都由其前一个
      状态构建而成。这正是“循环”一词的含义：记忆是一份持续演化的
      摘要，而非被存储的完整记录。
Nothing above ever stored the sequence..src: Nothing above ever stored the sequence. At step $t$ the cell only ever sees $x_t$ and the single carried number $h_{t-1}$ — yet $h_t$ depends on the whole history $x_1,\dots,x_t$, because each state was built from the one before it. That is what “recurrent” means: memory is a running summary, not a stored transcript.

With $|w_h| &lt; 1$ the influence of an.zh: 当 $|w_h| < 1$ 时，旧输入的影响呈几何式 @@T0@@衰减@@T1@@ — 网络只有短记忆，会忘掉脉冲。
With $|w_h| &lt; 1$ the influence of an.src: With $|w_h| < 1$ the influence of an old input decays geometrically — the network has a short memory and forgets the impulse.

With $w_h \\approx 1$ the state @@T0@@ho.zh: 当 $w_h \approx 1$ 时，状态能长时间 @@T0@@保持@@T1@@ 信息 — 这是最佳区间，却也是难以学到的刀刃边缘。
With $w_h \\approx 1$ the state @@T0@@ho.src: With $w_h \approx 1$ the state holds information for a long time — the sweet spot, but a knife-edge that is hard to learn.

With $|w_h| &gt; 1$ the state @@T0@@satu.zh: 当 $|w_h| > 1$ 时，状态会 @@T0@@饱和@@T1@@（经由 $\tanh$）或 @@T2@@爆炸@@T3@@（线性）— 正是这种不稳定性使深层 RNN 难以训练。
With $|w_h| &gt; 1$ the state @@T0@@satu.src: With $|w_h| > 1$ the state saturates (through $\tanh$) or explodes (linear) — the same instability that makes deep RNNs hard to train.

@@T0@@Where this goes next.@@T1@@ Becaus.zh:
@@T0@@后续如何展开。@@T1@@ 由于 $h_t$ 是通过重复应用同一个
      单元构建的，训练它就意味着要对整条链求导 —
      @@T2@@时间反向传播@@T3@@。又因为每一步都大致乘以
      $w_h$，梯度会随序列长度呈指数式缩小或增大。LSTM 与
      GRU 的存在，正是为了给状态提供一条更平缓、带门控的时间通路。
@@T0@@Where this goes next.@@T1@@ Becaus.src: Where this goes next. Because $h_t$ is built by re-applying one cell, training it means differentiating through that entire chain — backprop through time. And because every step multiplies by roughly $w_h$, gradients shrink or grow exponentially with sequence length. LSTMs and GRUs exist precisely to give the state an easier, gated path through time.

meta.title: 观察 RNN 的状态演化
meta.tagline: 手工推演一个标量 RNN，观察整个序列如何折叠为一个持续演化的数值
meta.summary: 循环网络就是一个微小单元被反复应用。设定 w_x、w_h 与 b，喂入一个输入序列，按步进以推进 t=1,2,3… — 每次按动都会展示代入具体数值后的精确运算 h_t = tanh(w_x·x_t + w_h·h_{t-1} + b)，随后在轨迹上绘出新的状态。调高 w_h，观察状态在 tanh 下饱和，或在线性模式下爆炸：整个梯度消失 / 爆炸问题尽在这一个旋钮之中。
highlights: 一个时间步一个时间步地推演这一递推，看到 h_t = tanh(w_x·x_t + w_h·h_{t-1} + b) 以实际代入的数值计算出来。
将隐藏状态轨迹随时间 t 绘出，并附有当前权重走向的浅色预览。
可喂入脉冲、阶跃、交替、尖峰或斜坡输入 — 也可自行输入以逗号分隔的序列。
将循环权重 w_h 调至超过 1，观察状态在 tanh 下饱和或在线性模式下爆炸。
理解其要旨：一个共享单元将整个序列折叠为一份持续演化的摘要。
